ambient_events: Metal contracts somewhere in the wreck with a bang that rolls off flat across the flats.
A tanker car settles a half-inch with a groan and a shower of rust.
description: A rail siding chokes on its own collapse here — tanker cars derailed and stacked, spines snapped, spilling decades-dry chemical crust across the ballast. The rolling stock is a mountain of salvage nobody's been desperate enough to climb. Yet.
name: The Rail Throat
